purpose: Country-specific playable opening scenario. Factory counts/types, built starter mines, starter stock and fallback labor/utility capacity are explicitly simulation-only game values, not factual reports of real-world installed factories, mine ownership, warehouse inventory, mine output or geological reserves.

invariants.factories: Permanent unique built asset IDs. They do not expire with the 100-day supply authorization. Existing assets are preserved and IDs are deduplicated.
invariants.mines: Starting built mine assets are explicitly listed per country and then reconciled against the canonical bound site registry at runtime. Site rows not in this startup plan remain available for normal construction, not silently counted as built.
invariants.stocks: Numeric opening quantities are stored in this baseline and seeded once to the existing raw warehouse/inventory/batch ledgers. Stocks are finite and consumed; no Day-100 refill; no geological reserve is counted as inventory.
invariants.evidence: All generated starter asset quantities and simulated rates are labeled gameplay-only; no source reserve/status/evidence is rewritten.
invariants.catalog: Only existing 21 factory profiles, 22 recipes and 41 canonical resource IDs are used.

factoryCountRule.missingData: One scenario factory; missing country statistics remain null.
factoryCountRule.scenarioTier: small/emerging/industrial/advanced factory mix is a gameplay-balance assumption.

mineRule.siteEligibility: Positive canonicalized reserve and positive canonicalized daily rate, commercial extraction allowed, known resource identity, unique site ID and map-ready canonical registry match.
